note_route_count: architecture.md's literal API surface block (lines 698-727) lists 30 distinct method+path routes, not 28 as the task summary counted. This fixture freezes all 30 verbatim; see docs/contracts/widget-site-layout-api.md for the discrepancy note. Routes 31->32: GET /catalog/manifests/source-fingerprint is the disclosed pure-read companion for the browser materialize flow (echoes the current source fingerprint as expected_source_fingerprint). Routes 32->35: the placement content routes (POST /layouts/{uuid}/draft/placements, PATCH .../placements/{placement_uuid}/content, POST .../placements/{placement_uuid}/duplicate) from Unified Widget Catalog Part 2 Task 3. Routes 35->36: GET /layouts/{uuid}/draft/changes (the publish dialog's change list) from Unified Widget Catalog Part 2 Task 5.

sync_status.note: sync_status: pending is Gate-0 legacy Definition sync ONLY (named durable retry owner plus last-known-good artifact identity). Every Site Layout Version mutation returns ready because Blob verification and Manifest approval prerequisites precede Version creation; pending approval is 422 with no Version, pre-transaction build/storage outage is 503 (architecture.md 'Committed mutation and sync semantics', D-008).

Idempotency-Key header required; expected_draft_revision is the current Draft's lock_version (409 WIDGET_DRAFT_STALE when it moved). Unified Widget Catalog Part 2 Task 5 (routes 35->36): the publish dialog's change list, data[] of {kind: added|removed|changed, slot_key, slot_label, slot_label_key, widget_name, scope_type, scope_label} comparing the current Draft with the live Release. WidgetPlacementResource.note: widget_instance_uuid (the referenced Instance's uuid) and the integer widget_instance_version are two FLAT fields, matching the PUT /layouts/{uuid}/draft and preview-sessions write-request rows exactly so a Draft reloaded via GET /layouts/{uuid}/draft round-trips back into a valid Save/Preview. widget_instance_uuid added as a disclosed post-freeze evolution alongside the GET draft read route (routes 30->31) -- see docs/contracts/widget-site-layout-api.md 'Disclosed discrepancies' section 3.

nested.contents: map<"<widget_instance_uuid>:<widget_instance_version>", {widget_id, widget_theme_id, widget_name, widget_display_name, schema, values, is_blocked}> -- what each Placement in this Draft shows (its pinned Instance Version), the widget's name (widget_display_name: in the request locale) and whether Core blocks it. The area editor reads placement content from here and never calls the /instances routes.
nested.placements: list<WidgetPlacementResource> -- each entry has the exact same frozen fields as WidgetPlacementResource: uuid, slot_key, scope_type, scope_key, target_type, target_id, widget_instance_uuid, widget_instance_version, position, enabled, rules
nested.instance_fingerprints: map<widget_instance_uuid, usage_fingerprint> -- one server-issued repin usage_fingerprint per Instance any Placement in this Draft references. The value is exactly what POST /layouts/{uuid}/draft/instances/{instance_uuid}/versions-and-repin validates its own `usage_fingerprint` request field against (this Draft's version/lock_version, the Instance's CURRENT version number, and the sorted uuids of Placements in this Draft referencing any Version of that Instance). Opaque: the admin canvas echoes the value for the Instance it repins and never recomputes it. Both this map and the repin validator derive the value from the one shared WidgetDraftUsageFingerprint primitive, so they cannot drift.

WidgetLayoutDraftResource.note: response_resource for GET /layouts/{uuid}/draft; mirrors WidgetLayoutResource.current_draft's version/lock_version pair plus the full placements[] array, plus instance_fingerprints so the admin canvas can reload a saved Draft AND repin a shared Instance without a false-positive WIDGET_USAGE_CHANGED. instance_fingerprints added as a disclosed post-freeze evolution -- see docs/contracts/widget-site-layout-api.md 'Disclosed discrepancies' section 4.
